Metadata.description: Alisher Zhuman (Алишер Жуманов) — Middle Frontend Developer at Tunduk, Bishkek. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Feature-Sliced Design.

Hero.windowClosed: Happy at the club, but will listen to offers

Card.title: Player card
Card.lead: Hover over the card or tap it to flip it.
bio: From Talas, lives in Bishkek. Middle Frontend Developer at Tunduk.
Graduated from college in information security, so he thinks not only about how a form looks but also about what someone might send through it. Now studying business informatics at university.
Has already closed backend tasks on a work project — and liked it. Wants to make that position his own.

Scout.title: Scouting report
Scout.strengths: Careful typing, layouts that fit any screen, accessible interfaces, fast-loading pages, Feature-Sliced Design architecture and an eye for form security.
Scout.growing: Backend: Node.js and NestJS, Java, SQL and PostgreSQL, API design and working with databases.
Scout.note: Sometimes sweats the small stuff: a stray pixel in the layout, a variable name. The coaching staff ask him not to hold on to the ball.

Match.title: Career as a match
Match.lead: Scroll down: the clock on the scoreboard runs with you.
fouls: Yellow card to Bugs for diving: “works on my machine”.
Second yellow, that’s red! Bugs are sent off. Until the next release.
Bugs are already in the dressing room. The referee asks not to disturb them.
commentary: Alisher beats three bugs and is one on one with production!
The referee shows a yellow card for !important in CSS.
VAR is checking: bug or feature? Feature. Play on.
Trusts the team, but re-checks staging after them — and is right more often than the backend would like.
The coach shouts from the touchline: “Type it!”
The ball hits the post. The post turns out to be legacy code.
Match stats: zero console.log in production. Almost.
Match.varDone: Goal stands: no offside, commit signed.

kickoff.title: Kick-off: in IT since 14
kickoff.text: First code, long before the first job.

academy.title: Peaksoft academy
academy.text: Front-end courses: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React. First training projects.

peaksoft.title: First-team debut: Peaksoft
peaksoft.text: Intern, then Junior Frontend. A gadget store, clinic bookings, an English testing platform. Taught students on the side.

codify.title: Transfer to Codify Lab
codify.text: Lead author of Codify GO: interactive coding lessons, points and levels, certificates, payments. Plus a student LMS and reports for curators.

clickfood.title: Transfer to ClickFood
clickfood.text: Middle Frontend. Food delivery as a Telegram Mini App: catalogue and cart for customers, a restaurant dashboard, reports for accounting.

tunduk.title: Middle Frontend Developer at Tunduk
tunduk.text: E-Accreditation: the public portal and the staff dashboard, almost entirely on his own.

assist.title: Moves the team
assist.text: Gathers the requirements for the backend, chases design and testing. When the team isn’t around, he’s his own designer, backend and analyst.

kuttukTime.title: Solo run: KuttukTime
kuttukTime.text: His own product: gift certificates from local businesses in a Telegram Mini App. Front end and backend entirely his own, with online payments.

substitution.title: Substitution: on in a backend role
substitution.text: In progress… Java, Node.js, NestJS, SQL and PostgreSQL.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.lead: What he has worked on, club by club.
Projects.pageLead: Every project, club by club: from the first training ones to today’s.
Projects.metaDescription: Projects by Alisher Zhuman (Алишер Жуманов): GovTech, food delivery, EdTech, IoT and his own product. React, Next.js, TypeScript.

kca.title: Kyrgyz Center of Accreditation
kca.description: E-Accreditation: a public portal with registries and news, and a staff dashboard with step-by-step applications and access roles.
did: Public portal on Next.js: static generation, SEO markup, dark theme, Kyrgyz and Russian.
Staff dashboard on React and MUI: data tables, validated step-by-step forms, a rich text editor.
Feature-Sliced Design with automated checks, tests in Vitest and Playwright.

kuttukTime.description: A gift certificate for a coffee shop, spa or salon with no sign-up: the code can be sent to a friend and the merchant redeems it in their dashboard. Includes an admin for merchants and categories.
did: Backend on NestJS and PostgreSQL: sign-in via the Telegram signature, JWT and roles.
Payments through Finik: signed requests, verified webhooks, repeated deliveries never double-charge.
The React Mini App: buying a certificate, a code to share, the partner dashboard.

kiu.description: Site and CMS for the Kyrgyz Islamic University in three languages: news, faculties, timetables and a section for applicants. Staff manage the content themselves.
did: Three languages with next-intl: localized URLs, hreflang in the sitemap, the locale passed to the API.
A CMS for staff: news, schedules, faculties, file uploads to AWS S3.
Server-side prefetching with React Query, Feature-Sliced Design.

bilimBulak.description: A psychological diagnostics platform for teachers, built for the Ministry of Education and the Teachers’ Union: tests, burnout detection and personal recommendations.
did: Tests that keep answers through failures: local saving, a single attempt, auto-submit on timeout.
Step-by-step sign-up with OTP and cascading choices: region, district, organization type, institution.
Kyrgyz and Russian with next-intl, forms on React Hook Form and Zod.

quant.description: Smart water meters: a landing page in three languages and a dispatcher dashboard with consumption charts and remote valve control.
did: A landing page in three languages: hreflang, OpenGraph, lazy-loaded heavy modules, light media.
The dispatcher dashboard: consumption charts in Recharts and remote valve commands.
Hover-intent prefetching with React Query, Feature-Sliced Design.

clickfood.description: Food delivery in Telegram: restaurant search sorted by distance, a cart with modifiers, promo codes and cashback, and a partner dashboard with a stop list.
did: A Telegram Mini App on React and TypeScript: Feature-Sliced Design, React Query and Zod.
Checkout: dish modifiers, promo codes, cashback, delivery zone checks on the map.
Restaurant search by distance and a partner dashboard with a stop list and iiko integration.

turan.description: An admin panel for smart meters: users, devices, readings, remote water shut-off, access roles and Excel import.
did: Remote water shut-off and four levels of access roles.
Device import from Excel, search and filters that live in the page URL.
React Query caching for frequent readings, Zod validation, a Vite build.

billingCenter.description: Utility bills paid in four steps: provider, account number, amount due and a QR payment. Plain JavaScript, without a single library.
did: Payment in four steps: provider, account number, debt and a QR code that opens the banking app.
Three utility providers in one place and a PDF invoice.
Plain JavaScript with no npm packages, an accessible modal that closes on Escape.

codifyLms.description: CRM and LMS for training centres: homework with a code editor, leaderboards and coins, reports to parents over WhatsApp.
did: Monthly reports to parents: an editable table and WhatsApp delivery with retries.
Assignments in a TipTap editor with code highlighting, file uploads and mentor comments.
Course and global leaderboards, digital literacy tasks with text-to-speech.

codifyGo.description: Micro-lessons in HTML, CSS and cybersecurity: a code editor right in the browser, levels and streaks, a subscription and an olympiad for schoolchildren.
did: Gamification: XP and levels, coins, streaks and daily goals.
Stripe subscriptions: monthly and yearly, paid lessons and promo codes.
A CodeMirror editor with a live HTML and CSS preview, olympiad sign-up with a PDF certificate.

virtualAccelerate.description: A platform for accelerators: startup selection on a kanban board, investor voting, a form builder and 8 languages including RTL.
did: A Kanban board for selecting startups: drag and drop, bulk actions, scoring and comments.
A deal flow with investor voting, role permissions through CASL.
A no-code form builder, role-based analytics and 8 languages, including right-to-left Arabic.

jobCodify.description: A careers platform: jobs, courses, an AI résumé helper and a sandbox for running code in the browser.
did: Job filters on Redux with API queries and state that survives SSR.
A sandbox that runs JavaScript, React and Python right in the browser.
Sign-in with Google, Telegram or a password on NextAuth, silent token refresh, Sentry monitoring.

codifyAcademy.description: A site for programming, design and management courses for children and adults: enrolment, a free lesson and a career aptitude test.
did: Five ways to apply: forms, a free lesson, a checklist and a career aptitude test.
Separate pages for adults and kids, international phone number validation.
Svelte instead of React for speed, content from a Django CMS, Russian and English.

codifyTeens.description: A landing page for a coding academy for ages 7–17 in three languages: a fee calculator, a map and an application form.
did: A landing page on Next.js and Tailwind with meta tags in three languages via SSR.
Framer Motion animations, a school map, an Instagram feed and a price calculator.
An application form on React Hook Form with live validation.

startupNation.description: The landing page of Central Asia’s largest hackathon: registration, speakers, mentors and the prize fund.
did: A hackathon landing page with content from the API and a partner showcase.
A learning dashboard: courses, quizzes, assignments, a forum and a cart.
GSAP parallax and particles without the slowdown: server and client components kept apart.

codifyLab.description: A development studio’s site: case studies and services from a CMS, a brief form with attachments, Russian and English.
did: The site picks its language from the visitor’s browser, Russian or English.
Case studies and services from the CMS in a carousel: managers add projects without a developer.
A brief form with attachments and a layout that holds down to the narrowest screens.

alphaCargo.description: Cargo between Kyrgyzstan and Russia: shipment tracking by waybill, a rate calculator and a contract wizard for businesses.
did: Cargo tracking by waybill number with a timeline and a shareable link.
A tariff calculator and PDF waybills: viewed on desktop, downloaded on mobile.
A four-step contract wizard on React Hook Form.

shine.description: An admin panel for an aesthetic clinic: doctors, procedures, reviews and news with a rich text editor.
did: An admin panel with JWT sign-in, protected pages and roles.
Doctors and procedures: categories, descriptions, before-and-after photos, three price tiers.
Reviews and news in a CKEditor5 editor, bulk photo uploads.

peaksoftHouse.description: An IT course site: online enrolment, course pages, student projects and an admin panel for two offices.
did: Apply from anywhere on the page: a countdown, modal forms, a WhatsApp button.
An admin panel for banners and promotions with roles for the Bishkek and Moscow offices.
SSR on Next.js, lazy images, scroll animations, meta tags in three languages.

bilingual.description: English testing: 9 question types, voice recording and anti-cheating protection.
did: 9 question types and voice recording with a live waveform.
Anti-cheating on browser APIs: PrintScreen blocking, tab-switch detection.
Answers are saved as you go: after a reload the test resumes where it left off.

airbnb.description: Home rentals in Kyrgyzstan: filters and search, moderated listings, favourites.
did: Filters by region, type, price and rating with instant search.
A listing form with photos and moderation statuses, an admin queue for requests.
Google sign-in on Firebase and favourites.

healthCheck.description: A medical service: booking a doctor in five steps, test results online and doctors’ schedules for the admin.
did: Booking a doctor in five steps and a request queue in the admin panel.
Doctor schedules with bulk time-slot operations.
Roles and Google sign-in, Excel reports and test results as PDF.

peaksoftLms.description: A platform for managing courses, students and teachers: editors for course materials, graded assignments and importing students from Excel.
did: Three text editors for course materials, file and video uploads.
Student import from Excel, a trash bin for safe deletion, group management.
Graded assignments and student progress tracking.

gadgetarium.description: An online gadget store: catalogue, comparison, wishlist, Stripe checkout and a product admin.
did: Stripe checkout with form validation on Formik and Yup.
Lazy loading, debounced search and skeletons in the catalogue.
A product admin with a step-by-step wizard; favourites, history and comparison on Redux Persist.
